chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): No forty days pass for a believer without the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, presenting him with pain in his body or loss of his wealth or an affliction for which he is rewarded.

key_terms.تَعَاهَدَهُ: He attended to him / He ensured for him

ai.seo_question: What happens to a believer if they go forty days without any trial or affliction?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) explains that if forty days pass without a believer experiencing some trial, God will ensure they receive pain in the body, loss of wealth, or an affliction, all of which serve as means of reward (ajr) for the believer.
